{{ArcaneBox}}
'''Residual Viremia''' is an [[Arcane Enhancement]] for [[Kitgun]]s that grants them the ability to create a pool of {{D|Toxin}} on kill.

Can be sold for {{cc|‍1,000}}.

==Effect==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! Rank
! Chance
! Duration
! Range
! {{D|Toxin}} Damage/Second
! Buff Radius
|-
| 0 || 20% || 3s || 9m || 40 || 9m
|-
| 1 || 20% || 6s || 9m || 40 || 9m
|-
| 2 || 20% || 9s || 9m || 40 || 9m
|-
| 3 || 20% || 12s || 9m || 40 || 9m
|-
|}

==Acquisition==
Residual Viremia can be acquired from Rotation B of [[Isolation Vault|Isolation Vault Bounties]] (normal and [[Isolation Vault#Arcana|Arcana]]).
{{Acquisition|name=Residual Viremia|header=no}}

==Notes==
*Residual Arcanes can only have '''two''' active puddles at a time. For example; creating two puddles with a primary kitgun will prevent both your primary ''and'' secondary kitgun from creating any until the first two expire.

==Trivia==
*''[[Wikipedia:Viremia|Viremia]]'' refers to the entry of viruses into the bloodstream.
*The Orokin Writing on the Residual Viremia's image roughly translates to "Viremia".

==Bugs==
*Is supposed to have a 20% status chance, but it appears to be bugged and has no status chance at all. 

==Media==
<gallery widths="300" position="center" spacing="small">
ResidualViremiaAoE.png
</gallery>

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|35.5.6}}
*Fixed Residual Arcanes not triggering while riding Merulina.

{{ver|32.0.9}}
*Fixed damage types from equipped weapons applying to Mag’s Shards while she is standing in a zone created by Residual Arcanes. 
**''The Arcane effects apply only to weapons, her Shards will only apply Slash damage as intended while in these zones.''

{{ver|31.6}}
;ARCANE STAT CHANGES PER RANK

We’ve adjusted the values of older Arcanes with the goal of making lower rank Arcanes more viable, and more desirable while collecting as a result. In short, there are three stats that each Arcane tends to have (speaking generally) -- for example, a percentage chance, a stat buff, and the duration of the buff. 

Certain Arcanes increase all of these stats per rank (making them scale exponentially), but we are changing it so that only one stat is affected by rank (making it scale linearly). The other stats will now be at the max-rank value regardless of the Arcane Rank, thereby buffing lower-rank Arcanes as a result.

;Residual Viremia*
On Kitgun Kill: 20% (was 5%) chance to create pool of toxic blood for 3s/12s, dealing 40 (was 10) Toxin Damage/s. Standing in the area applies the Toxin Damage type to Theorem Arcanes.

''*As a bonus for the four Residual Arcanes above, we’ve added some extra improvements - all four have had their buff radius increased to 9m, and each now has a 20% chance to proc their status type on all damage instances!''

{{ver|29.5.6}}
*Fixed Residual Arcane zone damage numbers not showing up for Clients.

{{ver|29.5}}
*Introduced.
}}

{{UpdateMe|Research Required: *Find more bugs, especially with mechanics already reported in the [[#Bugs]] paragraph. *Test more [[Weapons]]/[[Abilities]] with exceptions (i.e. {{Weapon|Syam}} melee with a wave attack), [[Area of Effect]], [[:Category:Second-stage Projectiles|Second-stage Projectiles]], etc. *Test more rare buffing effects on exceptional projectiles (i.e. the [[Bounce]] bonus of {{Weapon|Mandonel}}'s fully [[Mandonel#Notes|charged fire]] on the enemy thrown from {{A|Meathook}}). *Which debuffs stack with more fields of {{M|Stasis Field}}? *Which bonuses stack with more fields of {{Weapon|Mandonel}}'s fully [[Mandonel#Notes|charged fire]] and which are applied only once? *What is the buffing radius of a field from {{Weapon|Mandonel}}'s fully [[Mandonel#Notes|charged fire]]? *What is the buffing radius of a {{Weapon|Simulor}}'s primary fire/[[Simulor#Notes|singularity]] orb? **Does it grow after merging? *Does {{Weapon|Simulor}}'s primary fire/[[Simulor#Notes|singularity]] bonus {{D|Electricity}} combine with other elements? *Can any of the [[Archwing]] models create or benefit fom buffing fields? *Which [[Companion]] weapons and abilities can benefit from buffing fields? *Which bonuses stack with more fields of {{A|Energy Shell}}? }} {{Community}} {{Infobox |Box title=Buffing Fields |image=GyreNukorManyElectricProcs.png |caption={{E|Kosma Gokstad Officer}} suffering ~3 thousand {{D|Electricity}} procs }}
[[Buffing Fields]] (internally named Shield) are zones/entities which will modify the properties of any weapon damage coming through, that includes:
*[[Projectile]], [[Hitscan]], and [[Continuous Weapon|Beam]] shots from [[Weapons]] and [[Heavy Weapon]]s. *''Some'' [[Area of Effect]] shots, only if its [[Projectile]] form gets the buff first. **Standalone explosions that are already underway and happen to hit a buffing field do '''not''' benefit from it. **Initial hit and explosion apply status separately. *''Some'' projectile-based [[Abilities]], [[Augments]], and [[Precept]]s. *''Some'' projectile-based melee attacks. **[[Glaive (Weapon Type)]], {{Weapon|Deconstructor}}, and {{Weapon|Wolf Sledge}} throws do '''not''' benefit. *''Some'' operator [[Amps]]. **{{Weapon|Phahd Scaffold}} does '''not''' benefit. **Elemental damage bonuses do '''not''' improve [[Eidolon]] shield damage (unless it's a {{D|Void}} damage bonus). *Projectile-using [[Specter]]s, [[Companions]], Summons, and allied NPCs. **They should be standing inside or close to a buffing field to benefit effectively. *''Some'' projectile-based [[Gear]]. [[AoE]] attacks may benefit partially or not at all, even if the projectile does.
Usually a buffing field will grant 2 or more enhancements, and will prevent the projectile from receiving benefits of buffing fields from other sources.
